Anya: Heads-up — sampleapp auth oddity: if both REDWOOD_API_KEY and REDWOOD_PROJECT_KEY are set, the JS SDK picks REDWOOD_PROJECT_KEY and requests fail with 403. Repro steps below.

Anya: Repro:
```bash
export REDWOOD_API_KEY=sk-abc123
export REDWOOD_PROJECT_KEY=pk-xyz789
node sampleapp/index.js
# -> 403 with body: {"error":"invalid key scope"}
```

Raj: Hmm, I thought project keys are only for project-scoped endpoints. Which SDK version are you on?

Tom: sdk-js 0.21.0 (released last week) — likely regression from the cred lookup PR.

Carlos: Right — PR 417 swapped the priority: project key now wins over api key; we intended the reverse. @Tom can you confirm where that landed?

Tom: Confirmed. The lookup order got inverted in `auth/index.ts` around the new `pickCredential()` helper. Fix is trivial: swap the conditional and add a unit test for precedence.

Anya: Also: can we add a warning when both vars are present? It's an onboarding footgun for sample apps.

devex-bot: Created issue #4523 and linked a draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-js/pull/419

Raj: Can we also make the error message clearer when scope mismatch happens? Right now it surfaces a generic 403. Something like: "project key used for org endpoint — set REDWOOD_API_KEY or use a project-scoped endpoint".

Tom: I agree on clearer error text. I don't want to introduce an env flag to change precedence (no `REDWOOD_DEFAULT_SCOPE` please). Plan: restore original precedence (API key wins), emit a one-time console warning when both set, and improve the 403 payload to explain scope mismatch.

Carlos: Ops ask: can we backport to 0.20.x? Several customers pinned older minor and the sample apps are on that branch.

Anya: I'll coordinate with support for customers. If Tom can get a PR today we can cut 0.21.1 and backport a patch to 0.20.x.

Tom: PR is drafted, tests added (credential precedence test and e2e repro). Pushing changes now. cc @devex-bot for changelog entry.

devex-bot: Noted — scheduled release candidate 0.21.1 for 1712109900 and created backport issue.

Anya: Thanks — will add a quick sampleapp README note about env var precedence and file a cred-lint rule proposal to warn when both REDWOOD_API_KEY and REDWOOD_PROJECT_KEY are set. :thumbsup:
